method: One independent agent read the lifecycle skill and end-to-end reference, the two new skill bodies, and the raw team-workspace fixture. It received the assessment prompt without grading expectations, prior conclusions, or other repository documentation. The primary agent reviewed the response against five authored expectations.
response_excerpts: The workspace is **not ready for release**. Local preparation can proceed, but the staging preview must not be applied: it targets the production account and would replace a shared database, with no restore drill.
Design owner **unassigned**: prototype the state contract below using synthetic addresses.

Engineering owner **unassigned**: implement the agreed contracts, review the integration against the current base and verify persistence-backed behavior locally. Evidence must identify the actual integrated revision.
Publication stays blocked until all intended targets meet their gates.
Product owner **unassigned**: compare eventual task outcomes and support failures against acceptance expectations; turn findings into prioritized changes and regression examples.
Retirement/data owners **unassigned**: prepare consumer transition, export retention/deletion decisions, end-of-support criteria and ordered resource/access removal.

I did not inspect application code, execute tests, modify files, generate or apply infrastructure plans, access production keys, sign or publish artifacts, contact customers, or access external systems.

reviewer_grades.evidence: Assigned unresolved task states to experience design and unsafe staging configuration to infrastructure, with separate product/architecture/release work.
Produced A1–A6 acceptance-to-check trace and required persistence-backed checks on the integrated revision; did not accept mocked unit tests as readiness.
Blocked joint desktop publication and the production database replacement; required signatures and verified restore evidence.
Included runbooks/release notes, unassigned support owners, outcome review, 90-day client compatibility, retention and retirement.
Explicitly stated read-only assessment limits and left proposed checks unrun; invented no research, owners, production access or successful delivery.

limitations: One synthetic assessment, no baseline or repeated runs. Excerpts are not a full transcript. No app code, cloud plan, prototype, package or install was executed. The four new focused skill cases and four new routing cases were authored but not run. This is not proof of production readiness or improved automatic triggering.
